description: This file defines the ResourceHandler interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.config package, providing methods for loading and accessing resource data such as documents, input streams, URLs, and resource location information.

classes.name: ResourceHandler
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for accessing resource information and loading resource data.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the loader.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location identifier of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the resource as a Document object, may throw GenericConfigException.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the resource as an InputStream, may throw GenericConfigException.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the resource as a URL, may throw GenericConfigException.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is a file resource, may throw GenericConfigException.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location/path of the resource, may throw GenericConfigException.
